content: संमतिः {%f.%} .²1 Agreement. .²2 Concurrence, assent, approbation, approval. .²3 Wish, desire. .²4 Knowledge of self, knowledge of the soul, true knowledge. .²5 Regard, respect, esteem; कथमिव तव संमतिर्भवित्री सममृतुभिर्मुनिनावधीरितस्य <ls>Ki. 10. 36</ls>. .²6 Love, affection. .²7 Command, order. .²8 Honouring (संमानन); लोकानां स्वस्ति चैवं स्याद्भवेदस्य च संमतिः <ls>Rām. 7. 10. 40</ls>.
